DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: まずこの紙で筆の動きを試してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: First, please try moving the brush on this paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: もう花に色を塗りました。これを額に入れて持ち帰る作品にするのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 練習紙を持ち帰り作品だと思ったことを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've already colored the flowers. Is this going to be the piece I frame and take home?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your assumption that the practice paper is the piece to take home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その紙は練習用です。本番の材料は、練習の後でお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: That paper is for practice. We'll give you the actual materials after you practice.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 完成品の下絵だと思っていました。今の紙は練習として続け、本番の材料にはまだ触れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 練習と本番を分け本番材料にまだ触れないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was the outline for the finished piece. I'll continue on this paper as practice and won't touch the actual materials yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish practice from the actual piece and say you will not touch the actual materials yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。筆に水を含ませすぎると色が広がります。今の線を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Too much water in the brush makes the color spread. Please look at your current line.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 線の外へ色が出ています。本番前に、水を減らした状態でもう一本試してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水分過多を観察し減らした筆で再練習を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The color has gone outside the line. Before the actual piece, may I try another line with less water in the brush?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Observe the excess water and ask to practice again with a less wet brush. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その空いているところで試しましょう。筆の水分はこちらで調整を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's try in that empty space. I'll show you here how to adjust the brush's water content.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この状態なら線が広がりにくいですね。練習した花と本番の模様は同じにする必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 練習と本番の模様選択の関係を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The line doesn't spread as easily like this. Does the design on the actual piece have to be the same as the flower I practiced?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how choosing a practice pattern relates to the pattern for the actual piece. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 選べる模様を本番前にご案内します。練習用の花に決めた扱いにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll show you the available designs before the actual piece. We won't treat the practice flower as your final choice.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では模様の説明を聞いて選びます。練習紙は比較用に手元へ置き、本番材料が来るまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 模様説明後に選び材料到着まで待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll choose after hearing about the designs. I'll keep the practice paper beside me for comparison and wait until the actual materials arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will choose after the design explanation and wait for the materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備してお持ちします。筆はこの受け皿へ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll prepare them and bring them over. Please put the brush in this tray.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の品はこちらです。掛け紙はまだ付けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the item you reserved. We haven't attached the gift-paper band yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約は私の名前ですが、会社からの贈り物です。掛け紙にも私の名前が入るのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約者名と贈り主名義の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The reservation is under my name, but it's a gift from my company. Will my name go on the gift-paper band too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the difference between the reservation name and the gift-giver's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約のお名前をそのまま掛け紙へ使うとは限りません。入れる名義を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We don't necessarily use the reservation name unchanged on the gift-paper band. Can you confirm the name to put on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社名にしたいです。予約名を変更するのではなく、掛け紙の名義だけ別にお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約記録を維持し掛け紙だけ会社名にしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like the company name. Could you use a separate name only on the gift-paper band, without changing the reservation name?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Keep the reservation record and ask for only the gift-paper band to have the company name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。会社名の正式な表記をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the staff member. Do you have the company's official written name?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名刺があります。この表記でお願いします。会社の略称は使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名刺で正式表記を示し略称を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a business card. Please use this spelling. Please don't use the company's abbreviated name.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the official name on a business card and avoid an abbreviation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表記を控えました。宛先のお名前も掛け紙へ入れるご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've noted the spelling. Would you like the recipient's name on the gift-paper band too?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、そこは不要です。会社名だけ入れ、包装する前に文字を見せていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛名は不要とし包装前の文字確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, that isn't needed. Please put only the company name, and I'd like to see the lettering before you wrap it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the recipient's name is unnecessary and request to check the lettering before wrapping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が作成したものをお見せします。菓子の数量は予約どおりでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll show you what the staff member prepares. Is the quantity of sweets still as reserved?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、数量は変えません。掛け紙の会社名を確認してから、予約分を受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数量を維持し名義確認後に受け取ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'm not changing the quantity. I'll collect the reserved items after checking the company name on the gift-paper band.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the quantity unchanged and say you will collect after checking the name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。名義の確認が済むまで包装を進めずお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll wait without continuing the wrapping until the name check is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この糸端を、次の工程の前に整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: We'll tidy this thread end before the next step.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 糸を切ると聞こえましたが、張ってある縦糸を全部切るという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 糸を切る範囲の理解を問い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard you say to cut the thread. Does that mean cutting all the stretched vertical threads?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask again to check your understanding of which threads to cut. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いいえ。今示しているのは端に出た余分な部分です。張ってある糸には手を入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: No. I'm pointing to the excess part sticking out at the edge. Please keep your hands away from the stretched threads.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 範囲を取り違えていました。はさみはまだ使っていません。対象を一本ずつ指して確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未着手を報告し実物で対象を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I misunderstood the scope. I haven't used the scissors yet. I'd like to point to each target thread and check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report that you have not started and ask to check the targets on the actual item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認は私が実物で示します。機械を動かしたまま手を近づけないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll show you on the actual item for confirmation. Don't put your hands near it while the machine is running.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 停止してから、担当の確認を受けて見ます。隣の布にも同じ作業をしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 停止と担当確認を優先し隣の布への適用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll look after it stops and the staff member checks. May I do the same work on the cloth next to it too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize stopping and staff confirmation and ask whether the neighboring cloth is included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 隣の布は別の工程です。今回はこの一枚だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The neighboring cloth is at a different step. This time it's only this one piece.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この一枚に限ります。切った糸端を布の上に残すと混ざるので、回収先も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作業を一枚に限定し切った糸の回収先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll limit it to this one piece. The cut ends would get mixed in if I left them on the cloth, so please also tell me where to collect them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Limit the work to one piece and ask where the cut threads should go. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 回収はこの容器です。まず一か所、私と確認してから作業を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Collect them in this container. First, we'll check one spot together before continuing the work.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。停止と対象確認を済ませ、最初の一か所を一緒に確認してから続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最初の一か所を共同確認してから続けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. After stopping and checking the targets, I'll check the first spot together with you before continuing.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will continue only after checking the first spot together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その順番で始めましょう。判断がつかない糸は切らずに呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's start in that order. If you're unsure about a thread, call me without cutting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 目的地の住所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you know the destination address?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この建物です。足を痛めているので、正門に止めてもらえばすぐ入れると思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩行負担と正門で降りたい想定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's this building. My leg is injured, so I think if you stop at the main gate, I can go straight in.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difficulty of walking and your assumption about getting out at the main gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 正門から建物まで距離がある場合もあります。使える入口の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: There may be some distance from the main gate to the building. Do you have instructions about the entrance you can use?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約案内に来客入口とあります。正門と同じか分からないので、施設に確認してから乗りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来客入口の違いを施設へ確認してから乗りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My booking information says visitor entrance. I don't know whether that's the same as the main gate, so I'd like to check with the facility before getting in.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to check the different visitor entrance with the facility before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗る前に確認しましょう。こちらで待つ間、列の進み方は係に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check before you get in. While waiting here, please ask the attendant how the line works.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 係の方に一度列を外れると伝えます。施設へは、車で近づける入口も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列を外れる連絡と車の接近可否の確認を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell the attendant I'm stepping out of the line for a moment. I'll also ask the facility which entrance a car can approach.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to notify the attendant about leaving the line and check car access. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その確認ができたら、運転者へ入口名と案内を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you've confirmed, please show the driver the entrance name and directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 施設から入口名を聞けましたが、停車できる場所は運転者に確認する必要があるそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口は判明し停車場所は未確定と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The facility gave me the entrance name, but they said I need to check where the car can stop with the driver.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that the entrance is known but the stopping point is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、運転者と相談して乗車を決めてください。住所の画面も残しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then discuss it with the driver before deciding to ride. Keep the address screen available too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、住所と入口名を両方見せます。正門への停車を先に決めつけず、降車場所を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所と入口名で運転者に降車場所を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll show both the address and entrance name. I won't decide in advance on stopping at the main gate; I'll discuss where to get out.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will discuss the drop-off location with the driver using the address and entrance name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備ができたら係にお声掛けください。列への戻り方を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please tell the attendant when you're ready. They'll explain how to return to the line.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品についてご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the product?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このポンプが押せません。固まっているので、壊れている商品ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 押せないポンプを故障かと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't press this pump. It's stuck, so isn't this product broken?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a pump that cannot be pressed is faulty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 輸送中に押されないよう固定されているタイプか、表示を確認しましょう。売場の商品を無理に押さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the label to see whether this type is locked to prevent pressing during transport. Please don't force the products on sale.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ買っていない商品でした。押すのをやめます。使い始める時の解除方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未購入品を押すのを止め解除方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This was a product I haven't bought yet. I'll stop pressing it. I'd like to know how to unlock it when first using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Stop pressing an unpurchased product and ask how to unlock it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材の見本では、上部を指定方向へ回して解除します。実演用の見本で示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: With the sample in this learning scenario, you turn the top in the specified direction to unlock it. I'll show you using the demonstration sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 売っている方ではなく見本でお願いします。押せないから水を足す必要がある、とも思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実演見本を指定し水追加の思い込みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please use the sample, not the one for sale. I also thought it might need water added because it wouldn't press.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the demonstration sample and explain your assumption about adding water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 固定の解除と、中身を薄めることは別です。この商品は表示にない水の追加をしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Unlocking it and diluting the contents are different. Please don't add water to this product when the label doesn't instruct you to.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水は足しません。見本の上部が上がる位置を確認して、表示の手順どおりに使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希釈せず解除位置と表示手順を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't add water. I'll check the position where the sample's top rises, and use it following the labeled steps.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not dilute it; check the unlocked position and the labeled procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持ち帰る時は、未開封の商品を選んでください。見本は販売品ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: When taking one home, please choose an unopened product. The sample isn't for sale.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。解除した見本を買うのではなく、未開封の一本を選びます。家で最初に表示を読み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見本と販売品を分け未開封一本を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Rather than buying the unlocked sample, I'll choose one unopened bottle. I'll reread the label first at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the sample from stock for sale and choose one unopened bottle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未開封の商品はこちらです。使い方の表示を残してお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The unopened products are here. Please keep the usage label when taking it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更のご相談ですね。お引越しはお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're asking about an address change. Have you moved already?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 賃貸契約を昨日結びました。新しい住所へ今日変更できると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約日を理由に住所変更できると考えたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I signed the rental contract yesterday. I came because I thought I could change to the new address today.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the contract date allowed an address change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 契約した日と実際に住み始めた日は違うことがあります。入居のご予定を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: The contract date and the day you actually start living there may differ. Please tell us your move-in plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入居は来月です。今は以前の住所に住んでいます。新住所を現住所として申し出る段階ではありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入居は来月で現住所は旧住所だと整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm moving in next month. I'm still living at my previous address. I wasn't yet at the stage of declaring the new address as my current one.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clarify that move-in is next month and your current address is the previous one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な手続きや書類は担当が確認します。今日ほかに変更したい情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check the required procedures and documents. Is there any other information you want to change today?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話番号はもう変わっています。住所の予定変更と分けて、現在の電話番号の手続きを相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更済み電話番号の手続きを別に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: My phone number has already changed. Can I discuss updating my current phone number separately from the planned address change?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask separately about the procedure for the phone number that has already changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの変更について案内します。新居の契約書だけで本人確認が完了するとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain each change. The new home's rental contract alone may not complete identity verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持参した本人確認書類を見ていただきたいです。新住所の契約書を現在の居住証明とは説明しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人確認書類を示し契約書の意味を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like you to look at the identification documents I brought. I won't describe the new-address contract as proof of my current residence.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your identification documents and limit what the rental contract demonstrates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。住所については、実際の転居時に必要な手順も聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will check. You can also ask what address procedures will be needed when you actually move.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では今日は電話番号の変更条件を確認し、住所は入居後の手順をメモします。変更済みとは家族にまだ伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話番号の条件と入居後の住所手順を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then today I'll check the phone-number change conditions and note down the address procedure for after move-in. I won't tell my family the address has been updated yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the phone-number conditions separately from the address procedure after move-in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順でご案内します。二つの情報を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain in that order. Let's check the two pieces of information separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送する封筒はこちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this the envelope you want to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ここで封をして出したいです。中には署名した書類のコピーを入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 署名書類のコピー入り封筒を出したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to seal it here and post it. I put a copy of the signed documents inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to send an envelope containing a copy of signed documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先がコピーでよいかは、郵便局では判断できません。提出案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: The post office can't decide whether copies are acceptable to the recipient organization. Do you have their submission instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。署名済み原本と書いてありました。自分の控えを送るつもりになっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出案内を読み原本指定と控えの取り違いに気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do. They say signed originals. I had been planning to send my own reference copies.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the submission instructions and notice the mix-up between required originals and your copies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ封は閉じていませんね。内容を確認してから発送方法をご相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: You haven't sealed it yet, correct? You can discuss shipping methods after checking the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 原本は家にあります。ここで署名をコピーに足して済ませず、原本を取りに戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代用署名をせず家の原本を取りに戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: The originals are at home. I won't simply add signatures to the copies here; I'll go home to get the originals.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will return home for the originals without adding substitute signatures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、今日はまだ発送しないということでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then is it correct that you won't send it today yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。締切も家の書類で確認し、戻る時には原本と自分の控えを別の袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発送を保留し締切確認と原本控えの分別を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll also check the deadline in the documents at home, and when I come back I'll put the originals and my copies in separate bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hold off sending and decide to check the deadline and separate originals from copies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先の記入済み封筒はお持ち帰りください。発送方法は書類がそろってから案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take home the envelope with the address already written on it. We'll explain shipping methods once your documents are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。封筒は持ち帰り、原本の確認後に発送方法と到着目安を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒を持ち帰り原本確認後に発送方法を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll take the envelope home and ask about shipping methods and expected arrival after checking the originals.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take the envelope home and discuss shipping methods after checking the originals. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。中身の提出条件は提出先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the submission requirements for the contents with the receiving organization.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご乗車の方はどなたですか。

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私だけです。家族の鞄まで持ってきてしまいました。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見送り客の鞄との混在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Just me. I accidentally brought my family's bag too.
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the luggage is mixed with a bag belonging to the family seeing you off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらが車内へ持ち込む荷物ですか。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which bag will you take on board?

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この小さい方です。大きい方は家族へ返します。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持込鞄と返す鞄を指示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: This smaller one. I'll return the bigger one to my family.
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the bag you will carry on and the one you will return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 扉の前で渡さず、脇で確認してください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check at the side rather than handing it over in front of the doors.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。中の弁当だけ、小さい鞄へ移したいです。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 弁当だけ移したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to move just the packed lunch inside into the smaller bag.
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to move only the packed lunch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発車まで余裕はありますか。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have enough time before departure?

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今から移すと慌てそうです。弁当は手で持ちます。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時間不足で手持ちに変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd be rushed if I moved it now. I'll carry the lunch in my hand.
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Change to carrying it by hand because time is short. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗る鞄は確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you confirmed which bag you're taking?

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。小さい鞄と弁当を持ち、大きい鞄は返しました。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車する荷物の整理完了を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I have the small bag and lunch, and I've returned the large bag.
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you have finished organizing your boarding luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご自分の荷物だけ持ってお乗りください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please board with only your own belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査記録は書けそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be able to fill in the inspection record?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 測定器の数字と用紙の単位が違うようです。このまま写してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記録用紙と測定単位の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The measuring device's numbers and the form's units seem different. Can I copy the number as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the record form and measurement units. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which field on the form is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 厚さの欄です。数字は読めますが、表示単位を確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数字を読めるが単位不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The thickness field. I can read the number, but I can't confirm the displayed unit.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can read the number but do not know the unit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 推測で換算せず、検査担当に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check with the inspection staff rather than guessing a conversion.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。未確認の数値に合格印は付けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 合否記入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I won't put a pass mark on an unconfirmed measurement.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold off entering the pass-or-fail result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 測定した品は区別してありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you kept the measured item separate?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別のトレーに置きました。検査待ちと表示してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象品の分離と表示を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I put it on a separate tray. May I label it as awaiting inspection?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss separating the item and how to label it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に表示方法も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask the staff member how to label it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。単位がわかったら、同じ品をもう一度測ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後の再測定を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Once the unit is clear, I'll measure the same item again.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Offer to measure it again after confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その品と記録を残してお待ちください。担当確認後に記入を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep that item and its record and wait. Let's continue filling it in after the staff member checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 仕上げに入ってよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I start the finishing process?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その前に、この指の跡が気になります。消せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指跡の修正可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before that, this finger mark bothers me. Can it be removed?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the finger mark can be corrected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 直すと、周りの模様も変わることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Correcting it may also change the surrounding pattern.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 跡だけ消すのは難しいのですね。今の模様は残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 周囲の模様を守りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So removing only the mark is difficult. I'd like to keep the current pattern.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to preserve the surrounding pattern. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自分の作品の印として残す方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also leave it as a mark of your own work.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それもよいですね。触った場所が思い出になるので残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 体験の印として指跡を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: That sounds nice too. The spot I touched will be a reminder of the experience, so I'll leave it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the finger mark as a reminder of the experience. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 仕上げ後は表面を変えにくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: After finishing, the surface becomes harder to change.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今の状態を一度写真に撮って確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕上げ前の撮影確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'd like to take a photo of it as it is once and check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a photo check before finishing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮ってからお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let me know after you've taken it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。跡を残したまま、仕上げをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後の仕上げを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked it. Please finish it with the mark left as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request finishing after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。この状態で仕上げに進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll proceed with finishing it in this state.
